type Double = number
const XS: Double[] = [1.0, 2.0]
function elseIf(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  if (v === undefined) {
    return 'none'
  } else if (v > 1.5) {
    return 'big' + String(v)
  } else {
    return 'small' + String(v)
  }
}
function nestedTern(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  return String(v === undefined ? 0.0 : v > 1.5 ? v * 10.0 : v)
}
function two(xs: Double[], i: number, j: number): string {
  const a = xs[i]
  const b = xs[j]
  if (a === undefined || b === undefined) return 'none'
  return String(a + b)
}
function whileBreak(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  let n = 0
  while (n < 3) {
    n = n + 1
    if (v === undefined) break
    if (v > 0.0) n = n + 1
  }
  return String(n)
}
function presentBody(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  let out = 'p'
  if (v !== undefined) {
    out = out + String(v * 3.0)
  }
  return out
}
function guardThenSwitch(xs: Double[], i: number, k: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  if (v === undefined) return 'none'
  switch (k) {
    case 0:
      return String(v)
    default:
      return String(v + 1.0)
  }
}
function interp(xs: string[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  if (v === undefined) return 'none'
  return `v=${v}!`
}
export function c_elseif_out(): string { return elseIf(XS, 5) }
export function c_elseif_big(): string { return elseIf(XS, 1) }
export function c_elseif_small(): string { return elseIf(XS, 0) }
export function c_nested_tern(): string { return nestedTern(XS, 1) + nestedTern(XS, 9) }
export function c_two_out(): string { return two(XS, 0, 9) }
export function c_two_in(): string { return two(XS, 0, 1) }
export function c_while_out(): string { return whileBreak(XS, 9) }
export function c_while_in(): string { return whileBreak(XS, 1) }
export function c_present_out(): string { return presentBody(XS, 9) + presentBody(XS, 0) }
export function c_switch_g(): string { return guardThenSwitch(XS, 0, 1) + guardThenSwitch(XS, 9, 0) }
export function c_interp(): string { return interp(['a'], 0) + interp(['a'], 4) }
